goal: Ensure JSON-RPC batch error replies return distinct IDs and are not dropped after notifications
Prevents RPC clients from receiving misleading duplicate IDs or missing errors when sending invalid payloads
agreement: Broad support with all review suggestions addressed and no open objections
Supports fixing a spec violation that could confuse clients expecting unique batch response IDs (pinheadmz)
Verified the bug and confirmed that tests fail without the patch (janb84)
Suggested parsing each element into a fresh request, which the author adopted (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes an edge case in JSON-RPC batch handling where malformed requests reuse previous IDs
Only impacts batches containing invalid non-object elements, so the issue is minor and deferrable
